229AT checkerboard and reciprocal content-root refinement:
- Retain229AP all-odd sign packets and define
    a_diag=alpha_{-,-}alpha_{+,+},
    a_off =alpha_{-,+}alpha_{+,-},
    b_diag=beta_{-,-}beta_{+,+},
    b_off =beta_{-,+}beta_{+,-}.
  Exact checkerboard crosswalk:
    A_-=a_diag b_diag,
    A_+=a_off b_off.
- Define the analogous space-content central-sign factors
    c12_odd=c12,-c12,+,
    c21_odd=c21,-c21,+,
    C_-=c12,-c21,-,
    C_+=c12,+c21,+.
- Exact opposite-gap square carriers:
    a_diag^2|R-U,
    a_off^2|R+U,
    b_diag^2|R-V,
    b_off^2|R+V,
    (c12,-)^2|V-e,
    (c12,+)^2|V+e,
    (c21,-)^2|U-e,
    (c21,+)^2|U+e.
  Hence
    A_-^2|(R-U)(R-V),
    A_+^2|(R+U)(R+V),
    C_-^2|(U-e)(V-e),
    C_+^2|(U+e)(V+e).
- Under exact Pythagorean Euclid-root normalization:
    a_diag|s12,-, a_off|s12,+,
    b_diag|s21,-, b_off|s21,+,
    c12,-|s_a,-, c12,+|s_a,+,
    c21,-|s_b,-, c21,+|s_b,+.
  Thus edge signed contents divide opposite space-root cofactors and space signed contents divide opposite edge-root cofactors.
- Short-gap cross-content bounds:
    A_-^2(c12c21)_odd <= (R-U)(R-V),
    C_-^2(ab)_odd <= (U-e)(V-e).
- These are deterministic same-physical couplings, not independent density factors.
